instruction: Access the Chrome bookmarks manager where all your saved bookmarks are organized.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome bookmarks manager. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://bookmarks/. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal page.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar
Appropriate metric logic: is_expected_active_tab_approximate correctly strips query parameters and compares base URL to chrome://bookmarks/
Semantically correct expected value: chrome://bookmarks/ is the correct URL for Chrome's bookmark manager
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (access bookmarks manager) by verifying active tab URL
Logical correctness: data flow works properly - getter extracts URL, metric compares it, verification succeeds if URLs match
No postconfig needed: chrome:// internal pages don't require dialog state maintenance, URL check via accessibility tree is sufficient
